scope: Read-only clarification of the retained refresh-guidance comparison orientation; no changes to the old plan, raw runs, scores, usage or decision.
scorer_convention: First protocol.pairs.condition_ids item is labelled candidate; second is reference. The old [[0,1]] setup therefore makes automatic comparative labels opposite to the explicit product roles.
decision_readback: The retained product decision uses actual named runs, refresh arguments, request counts, background cancellation/completion and measured additional public bytes. It does not rely on automatic ratio/adoption labels; not-adopted remains supported by the same limited evidence.
new_comparison_action: Use environment_pairs [[1,0]] in the new smart-cache setup with e1=current candidate/e0=previous reference, before any new model send. Preserve original case/model/prompt/oracle/repetition and freeze the actual balanced order.
limitations: Do not copy old automatic candidate/reference labels or ratio direction into a product claim. No model rerun or retroactive plan correction is needed for this clarification.
